en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Ah, I should check the map
before heading to the chapel.

I sorta like this body. Not as much 
as Himiko likes hers, though.
Huh? You like these disappointing graphics?

They're not that disappointing, y'know?
They're kinda stylish. I like 'em.

I know, right!? They—
Wait...that was a compliment.

Well, we don't have time to be talking about
this! Let's hurry up and investigate!

Before we proceed to the chapel, why don't
we examine the map over there?

We can confirm together where everyone
was when the incident occurred.
Perhaps that will give us some sort of clue.

Miu's avatar should still be on the side 
of the chapel.
Let's head to the chapel right away!

But before that, let's check the map.
It's only our second time here.

I've been thinking about it for a while, 
but Kokichi and Kaito don't get along.

I trust you to help out Kaito.
Good luck with Maki.

<CLT=cltMIND>The two maps on the wall...
One of the mansion, one of the world.
<CLT=cltMIND>I'll check the map of the mansion first.

<CLT=cltMIND>The first floor has the salon, dining room,
kitchen, and bathroom. The second is the roof.

<CLT=cltMIND>We split up when looking for the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>secret of the outside world<CLT=cltMIND>.

<CLT=cltMIND>Kokichi had the salon, Tsumugi the dining room,
Kaito the roof, and Gonta the outside.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Map of the Mansion<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.

<CLT=cltMIND>This is the map of the entire
Virtual World.

<CLT=cltMIND>The world is surrounded by walls
in all four directions.

<CLT=cltMIND>There's a loading point in the middle,
so the map is split in two.

<CLT=cltMIND>No sight or sound can pass through
the map loading point.

<CLT=cltMIND>To get from the mansion to the chapel,
you *have* to go through this point.

<CLT=cltMIND>You also have to cross the river that
runs parallel to it.
<CLT=cltMIND>That's how this world is designed.

<CLT=cltMIND>...It's strange.
I feel as though there's some secret to this...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>"<CLT=cltSTRONG>Map of the World<CLT=cltSYSTEM>" has been added to the
Truth Bullets section of your Monopad.
<CLT=cltMIND>This map was made by Miu...
<CLT=cltMIND>Is that what's bothering me?

I understand... Looking at maps makes 
you feel calm, doesn't it?
Huh?

You're the type of kid who stares at maps
alone instead of playing at recess, aren't you?
Ah...I never did anything like that...
Don't forget we're here for you, bro!
You're not alone anymore.

You don't need to withdraw into a shell, 
you know?

*sob* I'm so proud of you...
You made friends with real people...not maps...

I'm investigating!
Just investigating...
